desc:
Ragdoll MMA is a physics-based mixed martial arts fighting game. Use boxing, roundhouse kicks, wrestling and ground-and-pound to win inside the RFC cage.

Challenge other players, fight Easy, Medium or Hard bots, or sharpen your skills in Practice.

- Physics-driven punches, kicks and ragdoll reactions
- Physical grabbing, takedowns and ground combat
- Knockouts, bone breaks and slow-motion X-ray finish replays
- Three one-minute rounds with scored decisions
- PC and controller support

Early development: controls and combat balance are still being improved. Open Controls from the main menu before your first fight.
